inspiration.source_location: Minimized from BUGS/MDEV-29932.sql: INSERT DELAYED with SET assignments
inspiration.observed_pattern: A delayed insert using SET-style assignments failed when the table name contained the keyword text SET.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one MyISAM row and one INSERT DELAYED ... SET statement against a table named delayed_set_min; the final read isolates parser keyword-boundary handling.

fixture_notes: The table name delayed_set_min must not cause SET detection to split the identifier; the delayed SET insert must persist the row.
determinism_notes: One fixed row, fixed storage engine, and ordered primary-key read; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE delayed_set_min (event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, payload VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL) ENGINE=MyISAM

steps.sql: INSERT DELAYED INTO delayed_set_min SET event_id = 1501, payload = 'parser-safe'

checks.sql: SELECT event_id, payload FROM delayed_set_min ORDER BY event_id
